data.name: Yashdeep
data.gender_notes: Yashdeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yash means joy and deep means deep. So, Yashdeep means the one who is filled with deep joy and prosperity. The name Yashdeep carries the meaning “Joy, prosperity, and success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yashdeep usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, prosperity, and success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yashdeep is a name that resonates with the deep joy and inner peace that comes from a strong spiritual connection.
data.etymology: Yashdeep belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, prosperity, and success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashdeep total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
